title: UBL activity diagram: the extraction report
description: How the extractor read the diagram: its own measurements per element, keyed by the model's ids, the questions it left open, and what splitting its graph into model and layout turned up. For review only - nothing is drawn from it. Written by tools/model_io.py.

titleReadings.description: free text blocks that were a lane title read a second time, with their place in the extractor's text list

findings.description: what the split found inconsistent in the reading

corrections.description: the ids of the corrections from tools/model-corrections.json applied to this model

uncorrected.description: the model and layout as read, before the corrections, in the graph's ids - so the split still joins back to the graph

uncertain.description: the extractor's own open questions, as it wrote them

formerIds.description: each id in the model, and the id the extractor's graph gave the same element (by reading order, or by position in its list where the graph gave none)

documentLanes.description: each document placed between two lanes, and the lane the reading had given it

unmapped.description: graph fields the split does not know, carried so nothing is lost

present.description: the graph's own fields, in its order, so it can be put back together exactly
